details.label: Habitat
details.value: Coastal, Mountain, Grassland, Hill, Arctic, Urban, Forest, Underdark

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: The veteran makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

entries.name: Longsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.
